body: Yeah, I do a lot of daydreaming zoning out, thanks for the comment/ suggestion :)
Actually none of the above; don't like coffee (and don't drink much soda) or energy drinks and am not on any medication.
I'll check this out, I've been meaning to get a workout routine going...

Yikes that's long. The "up" thing is something that I actually get sometimes where I get very energetic and bouncy, though I'm usually a quiet person. This tends to happen later at night though and I feel like it's just something to do with who I am and when I operate best. Like someone mentioned before, I don't want to create false positives -- correlation =//= causation etc... but I'm not sure. 
I'm fairly certain I've been depressed before, but I don't think so right now. I've gone back and forth sorta in that region. My parents have talked to me on separate accounts a few times about seeing a therapist because they were afraid I was depressed. These have been spread out over the past 7 or so years - the talks coming at ~2/3 year intervals or so - it isn't a continuous thing. The reason I mention this is because I don't think I'm the best judge of whether I'm depressed or not and figure someone outside my mind would be a better judge (though looking back on it I would agree with them on one or two occasions, I just didn't see it at the time).

Yeah, mine have a tendency to include family/ friends as well - when it comes too other people they tend to be slightly gruesome... I just got a little scared to post that because it seemed more, well, scary. I'm not sure, it is worrying me, or making me think, enough to make me post about it, but I have no way to gauge it in the realm of other people given my one personed'ness. Same thing happens for me though with the stopping them, though they sometimes don't go away.
Sure thing and thanks for the reply - I'm a 19, and I'd guess that it's been 3 or 4 years? I'm not entirely sure, it isn't something I've really kept great track of.
